decisions.reason: A newly launched seasonal Erzgebirge-style candle arch featured on the home page is likely a core novelty that the firm will keep for several Christmas seasons.
Christmas pyramids are the firm's established core category, and a home-page product launched in 2018 will normally stay in the range for years.
The electronic music box with interchangeable discs is a platform product that drives sales of accessory discs and motifs, so the firm has an incentive to keep it.
The motif platform is a complementary accessory to the music box system, and dropping it after one season would undermine the system concept, although it is only mentioned on the website.
The Christmas motif platform fits the seasonal core business and complements the music box, so it is likely to stay despite its lower prominence.
A Dresden-themed pyramid appeals to the regional and tourist market and is featured on the home page, so the firm will likely keep it.
